description: Unit test class for testing the ConceptDAO's functionalities within the OpenMRS core API. Contains test methods for retrieving concept sources, checking usage of concept map types and reference terms, purging concepts, and searching concepts using various criteria.

classes.name: ConceptDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the ConceptDAO, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest to run within a Spring context.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes the ConceptDAO instance before each test if it is not already initialized.

methods.name: AllConceptSources_shouldReturnAllConceptSources
methods.description: Tests that getAllConceptSources returns the expected number of sources when 'true' is passed.

methods.name: AllConceptSources_shouldReturnAllUnretiredConceptSources
methods.description: Tests that getAllConceptSources returns the correct count of unretired sources when 'false' is passed.

methods.name: isConceptMapTypeInUse_shouldReturnTrueIfAMapTypeHasAConceptMapOrMoreUsingIt
methods.description: Verifies that the DAO correctly identifies if a ConceptMapType is in use by at least one concept map.

methods.name: isConceptMapTypeInUse_shouldReturnTrueIfAMapTypeHasAConceptReferenceTermMapOrMoreUsingIt
methods.description: Verifies correct detection of usage of ConceptMapType associated with ConceptReferenceTerm.

methods.name: isConceptReferenceTermInUse_shouldReturnTrueIfATermHasAConceptMapOrMoreUsingIt
methods.description: Checks if a given ConceptReferenceTerm is in use by some concept mappings.

methods.name: isConceptReferenceTermInUse_shouldReturnTrueIfATermHasAConceptReferenceTermMapOrMoreUsingIt
methods.description: Checks if a ConceptReferenceTerm is in use by concept reference term mappings.

methods.name: isConceptMapTypeInUse_shouldReturnFalseIfAMapTypeHasNoMapsUsingIt
methods.description: Verifies that the DAO returns false when no concept maps are using a specific ConceptMapType.

methods.name: isConceptReferenceTermInUse_shouldReturnFalseIfATermHasNoMapsUsingIt
methods.description: Verifies that the DAO returns false when the ConceptReferenceTerm is unused.

methods.name: purgeConcept_shouldPurgeConcept
methods.description: Deletes the specified Concept from the database and verifies it is no longer retrievable.

methods.name: getConcepts_shouldNotReturnConceptsWithMatchingNamesThatAreVoided
methods.description: Ensures that voided concepts with matching names are excluded from search results.

methods.name: getConceptsByAnswer_shouldReturnConceptsForTheGivenAnswerConcept
methods.description: Tests retrieval of concepts that are answers to a given concept.

methods.name: getConcepts_shouldReturnCorrectResultsForConceptWithNamesThatContainsWordsWithMoreWeight
methods.description: Verifies that concept search results prioritize words with higher weights, testing the ranking mechanism.

methods.name: getConcepts_shouldReturnCorrectResultsIfAConceptNameContainsSameWordMoreThanOnce
methods.description: Tests handling of concept names containing the same word multiple times to ensure correct search ranking.

methods.name: getConcepts_shouldBeDiacriticInsensitive
methods.description: Validates that concept search ignores accents in names, matching regardless of diacritics.
